Subject: Redwood + AuroraMed — Exec summary & next steps (post-call recap)

Hi Priya / Michael,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the candid conversation. Below is a short executive recap for your team and ours, capturing the pain, desired outcomes, procurement path, and suggested next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points we heard:
- High latency for clinical-document summarization workflows leading to slower care-team throughput (avg 2-3 minutes per doc).
- Cost volatility and unpredictable spend on current inference infra.
- Data governance: need VPC/KMS controls and SOC 2 evidence for PHI-adjacent workloads.

Primary goals / success metrics (executive view):
- Reduce turnaround time for summarization to < 20s per doc at 95th percentile.
- Reduce per-document inference cost by ~40% through batching and caching.
- Maintain end-to-end auditability and key management acceptable for internal compliance.

Business outcomes & risk profile:
- Outcome: Faster discharge summaries and improved clinician productivity; estimated 3-5% increase in throughput across pilot sites (see attached ROI calc).
- Risk: Any model/regulatory regression; procurement/legal want clear data controls and SLA commitments.

Procurement path (what we heard):
- Internal pilot (clinical team + one hospital) -> security review -> procurement/contracting -> enterprise purchase.
- Target procurement decision: mid-July (your note).

Action items & owners:
1) Redwood: Provide SOW draft + SOC2 summary + ROI calc by EOD 6/1. (Owner: Marissa)
2) AuroraMed: Share procurement/legal contact + any contract redlines expected by 6/7. (Owner: Priya)
3) Redwood & AuroraMed exec alignment call (15-30m) to confirm success metrics — propose week of 6/7. (Owner: Marissa)
4) Technical deep-dive with infra/clinical engineers (to scope integration) — schedule after SOW. (Owner: Aditya)

Attachments: AuroraMed-MAP-20270601.pdf (map of pilot scope), Redwood-ROI-Calc.xlsx (estimate).

If that looks right, I’ll send the SOW and SOC2 summary tomorrow and we can lock a time for an exec call.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
